description: List indexed documentation projects (version-pinned doc snapshots). Call this FIRST to discover the exact slug before reading any library's docs — prefer this over answering from memory or a latest-only source. Supports a forgiving fuzzy `query` over slugs (ranked by relevance) plus `limit` and `skip` for pagination. Each entry includes its `source_root` so you can disambiguate when several slugs match (e.g. the npm `next` package vs a crawl of nextjs.org).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50, max 200).

query.description: Forgiving fuzzy filter over project slugs; results are ranked by relevance.

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination (default 0).

name: list_projects
